attacks.name: Dogpile
steps: If an allied |*Multiple Man| is within |!range| 2 of the defender during the |*Modify Dice| step, this character may reroll up to 2 of its attack dice.
|!wild| |*Slow|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§slow§Slow| special condition.

superPowers.name: X-Factor Investigations Workforce
superPowers.body: This character does not have to spend |!power| to Interact with objective tokens.

superPowers.name: Like Herding Cats
superPowers.body: This character cannot Interact with or Contest an objective token unless there is another allied character Contesting that objective token.|\|Additionally, when this character ends its Activation, if it is not within |!range| 3 of an allied |*Multiple Man|, it drops all objective tokens it is holding.
